messages:
sanjay: Hey team — onboarding a new GCP project for the APAC pilot: `redwood-syd-pool`. Need quota uplift and preflight checks for aus-southeast1. Primary ask: L4 (A2) chips for inference, and a small H100 fallback pool. Also need external IPs for egress testing and VPC peering with partner network.

leah: quick clarifying q — how many L4s and H100s are you requesting? and do you expect sustained usage or burst?

sanjay: Requesting 12 L4 (burstable) and 4 H100 (reserved for heavy batches). Mostly bursty during CI/eval runs, expected steady 3-4 concurrent L4 containers during daytime.

mia: tagging billing: billing contact is `eng-platform-billing@redwood.com` and project owner is `redwood-syd-pool@redwood-ops.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Estimate monthly run cost if we hit 50% average utilization: ~USD 35k (rough estimate). Leah — can you confirm cost calc?

leah: looks reasonable as rough order of magnitude. Two notes: 1) L4 spot vs on-demand split will matter a lot — recommend defaulting to 70% spot with 30% on-demand reserved. 2) egress external IP quotas often block tests; request 6 ephemeral external IPs to start.

alex: network side — we need VPC peering and route table approved by networking. Also please confirm if we need Private Google Access or NAT gateway for image pulls.

sanjay: we'll use NAT gateway for now. Peering request to partner net `partner-prod-syd` — I'll open ticket.

infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-2026: "GCP aus-southeast1 quota & network preflight for redwood-syd-pool". Please include project billing account and IAM owners in the ticket.

mia: added the project ID and billing in the ticket comment. Also attached minimal gcloud commands for quota export: 
```
# check current quotas
gcloud compute regions describe australia-southeast1 --project=redwood-syd-pool 
# request increase (via support ticket)
```

oncall-dev: I'll take ownership of the quota approval path. Two requirements before I escalate: 1) verify billing account is active and linked, 2) confirm deployment manifests include preemptible fallback and graceful degradation.

sanjay: billing is linked. manifests include fallback — see comment in the ticket with `deploy.yaml` snippet.

alex: small security ask — ensure the SA has only the required scopes: compute.networkAdmin and compute.instanceAdmin for the infra svc. Don't grant owner.

leah: one more ops point: please add metrics and alerting for GPU utilization + OOM job failures. If L4s are overloaded we should auto-fallback to H100 pool for long-running batches.

mia: copied an example alert rule into the ticket. Also flagged TPUs are not needed for this pilot.

oncall-dev: I'll push the quota uplift request to Google support. ETA on approval typically 48–72h for new region + quotas. If they ask for traffic patterns, we'll attach the day/hour utilization from the eval runs.

sanjay: thanks — can you also request temporary increase to external IP quota to 8 for 2 weeks so we can smoke test egress?

oncall-dev: noted — requesting 8 ephemeral eips for 14 days.

leah: cost tradeoff note in ticket: if dedicated H100s stay idle we should use autoscaler to shut them after 30m idle. Also consider using quantized replicas for L4 to reduce token cost.

alex: for the approval, networking asked for the proposed VPC peer routes and the NAT IP ranges. I'll add a small diagram in the ticket.

infra-bot: INFRA-2026 updated with attachments: `deploy.yaml`, `alerting_rules.json`, `vpc-peer-diagram.png`.

sanjay: perfect. thanks all — ping me in thread if Google requests any additional justification. :thumbsup:
